summary: This is a metadata document describing a Dockerfile analysis tool's output, showing version information and explanations for key Docker commands used to build a Node.js application image efficiently.

explanations.3: This specifies which Claude model was used to generate the explanations — haiku-4-5-20251001 is a specific version of Claude.
explanations.4: The ISO 8601 timestamp indicates when this analysis was generated.
explanations.8: The explanations object maps line numbers (as strings) to plain-English descriptions of what confusing Docker commands do.
